name: codex-memory
description: Local, data-free Codex memory plugin with read-only retrieval on every prompt and end-of-turn curation through MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Use a local memory store in every Codex conversation
interface.longDescription: Codex Memory retrieves relevant local memories before work, keeps explicitly mandatory records in scope, and requests precise end-of-turn curation. The database, relations, exports, logs, and hook context remain local.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Memory on every turn: retrieve relevant local memories before answering and curate confirmed reusable information at the end of the turn.
When a task is blocked, search local Codex Memory for the concrete error, application, environment, and operation before asking for help.
Use $codex-memory when you want to explicitly read, write, replace, retire, or mark local memories.
